scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/session-ui && npm run build --workspace packages/cli
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace packages/session-ui && npm run check --workspace packages/cli && biome check . && npm run pi:check
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/session-ui && npm run test --workspace packages/cli && npm run test:python && npm run test:pack-check && npm run test:release-metadata
scripts.test:python: uv run --project python/jouzu python -m unittest discover -s python/jouzu/tests -v
scripts.dev:link: npm run build:dev && npm link --workspace packages/cli
scripts.release:check:candidate: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run test:packed && npm run test:auto-update && npm run build:python && npm run check:python
scripts.pi:check:online: node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs check --online && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs latest --require-latest
scripts.pi:qualify: npm run pi:check:online && npm run release:check:candidate && node scripts/check-pi-contract.mjs && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs promote
scripts.release:check: npm run release:metadata && npm run release:check:candidate
